Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Brown (K)
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 04/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 419 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
